status: Accepted narrow qualification diagnostic; no warning suppression used.
diagnostic: ExperimentalWarning: stripTypeScriptTypes is an experimental feature and might change at any time
root_cause: The distribution Node 24 runtime deliberately labels the module.stripTypeScriptTypes API experimental. The same standalone transform executes successfully and emits the identical notice without Qore.

command: const assert = require('node:assert/strict'); const result = require('node:module').stripTypeScriptTypes('const value: number = 42; value;', { mode: 'transform' }); assert.equal(require('node:vm').runInNewContext(result), 42); console.log('TypeScript transform and execution passed');
